subject: Hosted API expansion: throughput pledge escalation & rate-band rebalance
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@lanternhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lantern Health Procurement <procurement@lanternhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API - forecasting a big surge, need pricing & rate band changes

Hey Irene / Karthik,

We're ramping up an LLM-driven feature set and expect a meaningful step-change in token consumption starting June. Current plan (200M monthly committed tokens) will be insufficient — our forecast attached shows a peak month at ~650M tokens and sustained 500-700M/month over the next 12 months.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood support a firm 750M monthly commit (12-month term) and what does pricing look like?
- We also need higher sustained rate limits for bursty traffic — target sustained 200 req/s with 600 req/s burst for short periods. If that requires a different rate-band, please propose the operational limits and any impact to unit pricing.

We'd like to start billing June 1 if we can finalize terms by mid-May. Attaching the monthly forecast and our procurement playbook.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Director, Platform Partnerships
Lantern Health

Attachments: Lantern_Monthly_Forecast_May2027.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@lanternhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API - forecasting a big surge, need pricing & rate band changes

Hi Priya — thanks for the forecast and the clear asks. Looping in Karthik (AE) and Marissa (Sales Lead) to own pricing/contracting. A few quick clarifying questions so we can put together a precise quote:

1) Is the 750M commit a hard monthly minimum or a stepped commit where you want to start at 500M and step to 750M?
2) For rate limits, when you say 200 req/s sustained and 600 req/s burst, are those per-account (global) or per-route? If per-route, which endpoints (chat/generation/embedding) will be busiest?
3) Any compliance or SOC2 evidence requests we should package with the SOW?

If you want, we can draft 2 options: a) 12-month firm 750M with preferred rate band and b) step-up commit (3-month ramp). Karthik / Marissa — can you draft options and include the rate-band/SDR pricing and a suggested SLA?

Best,
Irene
Director, Customer Success (Redwood Inference)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@lanternhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API - forecasting a big surge, need pricing & rate band changes

Priya — thanks for the prompt. Based on the forecast and typical Lantern traffic patterns, we recommend the following two commercial options (numbers are illustrative; see attached rate sheet & SOW draft):

Option A — Firm 12-month 750M commit
- Monthly committed tokens: 750,000,000
- Unit price: $0.95 per 1k prompt+completion tokens (first 6 months) then $1.05 thereafter
- Rate band (sustained): 200 req/s global; burst up to 600 req/s for 2 min windows, subject to tokens/second limits
- Burst credits: included 5 short bursts/month; additional bursts billed at $0.02 per token above baseline
- SLA: 99.9% availability for serving endpoints; credits for downtime
- Onboarding: 2-week prioritized rollout, KV cache tuning included

Option B — Step ramp (3 months) to 750M with progressive pricing
- Month 1: 400M at $1.10/1k; Month 2: 575M at $1.02/1k; Month 3+: 750M at $0.98/1k
- Rate band: 150 req/s sustained with configurable burst profile; can be raised to 200 req/s after month 2
- Short-term pilot credit available for first 60 days

Attachments: Lantern_MA-RateSheet_v3.pdf (pdf), Lantern_SOW_draft.docx (docx)

Next steps: if you prefer Option A we'll prepare a single amendment and a DocuSign envelope; if Option B we'll include a step schedule. Also, Marissa — can you confirm any early-payment or multi-year discount logic to include?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya@lanternhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Lantern Health Procurement <procurement@lanternhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API - forecasting a big surge, need pricing & rate band changes

Thanks Karthik — Option A is preferable because Lantern wants price predictability. Two negotiation points from procurement:

1) Can you keep the unit price flat at $0.98/1k for the full 12 months (rather than stepping up after 6 months)?
2) We need sustained 200 req/s global (not per-route). The burst profile is fine but we want at least 10 short bursts/month included (we have a few scheduled jobs that cause predictable bursts).

Assuming those two changes, procurement can sign with a 6-week lead time from contract signature (target billing start: 2027-06-01). Attaching internal approval memo.

Priya

On Fri, Apr 30, 2027 at 08:46 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Priya — thanks for the prompt. Based on the forecast and typical Lantern traffic patterns, we recommend the following two commercial options...

Attachments: Lantern_Internal_Approval.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@lanternhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T14:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API - forecasting a big surge, need pricing & rate band changes

Priya — appreciate the clarity. We can agree to a flat $0.98/1k for 12 months on a 750M firm commit with the following adjustments to make this mutually workable:

- Sustained rate: 200 req/s global (confirmed). Burst: 600 req/s short windows. We'll include 10 included bursts/month.
- New clause: temporary burst smoothing for month 1-2 if you exceed burst credits we'll proactively throttle at pre-agreed thresholds rather than immediate bill spikes.
- Commercial concession: instead of a straight unit-price reduction, we'll offer a promotional credit equal to 30% of invoice amount for months 1-2 (applied as account credit).
- Contract start: billing commences 2027-06-01; onboarding and configuration kickoff target week of 2027-05-16.

I'll prepare an amendment and send the DocuSign link. Can you confirm Lantern's legal requires any additional terms on data residency or support response SLAs?

Thanks — Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@lanternhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API - forecasting a big surge, need pricing & rate band changes (Final)

Hi all — quick update to confirm we received the signed amendment via DocuSign this morning and procurement marked the HubSpot deal as closed-won. Summary of agreed commercial terms below (please keep for the ops handoff):

- Commit: 750M monthly committed tokens, 12-month term (Deal: LN-2027-0582)
- Unit price: $0.98 per 1k tokens (flat for the 12-month term)
- Rate band: 200 req/s sustained global; burst to 600 req/s for up to 2-minute windows; 10 included bursts/month
- Onboarding: Kickoff week of 2027-05-16; prioritized KV cache tuning and prefix caching enabled
- Credits: 30% account credit applied to invoices for months 1 and 2 as promotional credit
- Billing start: 2027-06-01
- Attachments stored on deal record: Lantern_MA-RateSheet_v3.pdf, Lantern_SOW_draft.docx, Lantern_Monthly_Forecast_May2027.xlsx
- Operational notes: Ops to provision dedicated rate-limiter profile "LAN-750M-STD" and enable traffic shaping rules; CS (Irene) to coordinate post-sign onboarding and weekly usage checkpoints for first 8 weeks.

Karthik / Ben: please confirm provisioning ETA and open any provisioning tickets before 2027-05-30 so we meet the June 1 billing date.

Thanks everyone — excited to get Lantern live at scale.

Irene Choi
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
